name: bodyscale-electron-example
description: Minimal Electron app that reads a Dr Trust SSW533 body scale through the bodyscale service

build.//comment-extraResources: Everything the service needs is copied beside the app, NOT into app.asar. Python cannot read a script out of an archive, and an interpreter cannot be spawned from one.
build.//comment-asarUnpack: Redundant with extraResources here, but harmless, and it saves you if you ever move the scale inside files[].

mac.//comment: macOS refuses Bluetooth to any app whose Info.plist lacks this string, and kills the process rather than prompting.

extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Connects to your body scale to read your weight.
